status: preregistered protocol; no candidate measurement is recorded here
authority: 02-architecture.md sections 7-10, 04-implementation-plan.md item 4, and the retained 02c agreement contract

thresholds.population: 300 non-null sidewalk readings from all 150 retained fixtures
thresholds.derivation: Retained 02c gate; it is a candidate-versus-fixed-reference comparison, not physical accuracy.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail the candidate agreement gate; do not change the ceiling, corpus, denominator, reference pixels, or width policy.

thresholds.population: same 300 non-null readings; nearest-rank percentile
thresholds.derivation: Retained 02c gate.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail the candidate agreement gate.

thresholds.population: same 300 non-null readings; strict disagreement > 0.25
thresholds.derivation: Retained 02c gate.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail the candidate agreement gate and retain the complete severe-tail listing.

thresholds.population: non-null readings separately for Madrid, Singapore, and Kent WA
thresholds.derivation: Retained 02c gate.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail the candidate agreement gate even if the aggregate mean passes.
savedEvidence: per-city counts, null totals, exclusions, and means

thresholds.population: all 2,020 scheduled evaluations overall and separately by city
thresholds.derivation: Retained amended 02c contract; it guards corpus validity and is not a routing policy threshold.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail the candidate agreement gate; report nulls separately and do not score them as agreement readings.

thresholds.population: quantized synthetic plane, roof, crown, and seam fixture coordinates
thresholds.derivation: One 1/64 m canonical-height quantum. The independent oracle evaluates the same declared quantized inputs; this bounds representation comparison only, not terrain/source error.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail the analytic fixture; do not present the kernel as conformant for that geometry.

thresholds.population: non-tangent analytic ray/plane/interval cases
thresholds.derivation: For declared non-tangent inputs the independent exact-or-high-precision oracle has an unambiguous hit, validity, completeness, and building-only result.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail the fixture. Tangent cases are separately classified as indeterminate inside the declared uncertainty band, never counted as a passing hit/miss.

thresholds.population: matched fixture receiver/time/generation outputs, including fractional canopy
thresholds.derivation: Float32 comparison budget after both consumers receive identical canonical Float32 material/solar inputs; it is not an optical or physical error allowance.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail numeric renderer conformance; keep the renderer inactive and retain the pair's identities and raw outputs.

thresholds.population: matched validity, completeness, building-only termination, and generation fields
thresholds.derivation: These are discrete shared-field semantics, not measured physical quantities.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail numeric renderer conformance and reject the affected output as complete.
savedEvidence: failure trace if injected corruption is used

thresholds.population: all forced one-page/few-page continuation fixture outputs versus resident exact evaluation
thresholds.derivation: Same canonical inputs and deterministic traversal; continuation is a scheduling change, so no numerical difference is allowed.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail streaming/ledger conformance; mark interrupted work incomplete rather than publishing an answer.

thresholds.population: each admitted fixture or later device request across retained pages/jobs/targets
thresholds.derivation: 02 section 7 budget: 160 MiB pages, 16 MiB staging, 8 MiB continuations, 8 MiB output. It is an admission target, not measured phone evidence.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Reject or make the request incomplete; never remove casters or samples to fit it.

thresholds.population: each named phone/browser/GPU profile during full-app qualification
thresholds.units: MiB runtime/driver increment above managed accounting
thresholds.derivation: 02 section 7 reserve. It becomes a pass/fail threshold only after a profile and measurement method are admitted; no host or SwiftShader result satisfies it.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Reduce managed admission or reject the profile; activation remains blocked for that profile.

thresholds.population: one end-to-end request through acquisition, decode, composition, query/render readiness
thresholds.derivation: Settled single shared readiness allowance in 02/04; it cannot be restarted for each source or phase.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Record incomplete/not-ready for the request; no complete 3-degree claim for the failing profile/domain.

thresholds.population: named device/browser full-app interactions, reported separately from correctness
thresholds.derivation: 04 item 19 requires 30/50 ms targets to be reported separately; no previous benchmark is a pass.
thresholds.failureConsequence: No device envelope or event-performance claim for the failing profile; correctness results remain separately reported.

thresholds.population: named device/browser cached-route requests under the admitted workload
thresholds.derivation: 04 item 19 reporting target; it is not established by a kernel or host run.
thresholds.failureConsequence: No cached-route performance claim for the failing profile.

thresholds.population: constant-transmission analytic fixtures
thresholds.derivation: The integral of constant transmission over declared durations is exact in the fixture model.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail exposure conformance; do not emit a successful numeric export.

thresholds.population: single controlled transmission-transition fixtures with declared maximum step
thresholds.derivation: Half of the preregistered maximum 0.25-hour integration step bounds a single unresolved step transition. This is integration discretization only, not atmospheric or physical error.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail exposure conformance or reduce the declared step before rerunning.

thresholds.population: all exported Float32 fixture pixels, nodata/valid-duration values, CRS/geotransform and required metadata
thresholds.derivation: An independent GeoTIFF decoder reads serialized bytes; exact Float32 bits and declared fields must round-trip.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Fail numeric export; an RGB export cannot substitute.

thresholds.population: at least 36 independently georeferenced NYC observation events, selected before candidate evaluation with at least six events in each of opaque-ground, roof/wall, crown, open-control, low-sun, and part/courtyard strata; strata may overlap but all events remain individually retained
thresholds.derivation: Coverage requirement for a future protocol, not a confidence or accuracy claim. The residual tolerance remains deliberately unadmitted until the independent control/georeferencing error budget is signed before analysis.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Block physical-validation acceptance and all physical-accuracy claims, even if method agreement passes.

thresholds.population: future independently controlled NYC observation events selected by physical-observation-design
thresholds.units: m and angular degrees, pending a signed independent control/georeferencing error budget
thresholds.derivation: No source, observation-registration, temporal, or optical uncertainty budget has been admitted. A numerical value would be postulated rather than derived.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Physical accuracy and activation remain blocked; method agreement, analytic conformance, and device tests cannot substitute.

thresholds.population: each required evidence package for a scoped OI, release, or separately authorized deferred capability
thresholds.derivation: A claim is admissible only when every required saved artifact named by its case entry is retained, hashable, and reproducible. This is an evidence gate, not a physical or performance metric.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Keep the OI open and make no corresponding capability, vendor-parity, release, or accuracy claim.
